candidates.change_summary: Replace `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>block.timestamp?_unlockTime:block.timestamp;` with `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime;` to always set unlockTime to the argument without clamping to block.timestamp.
Replace `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value);` with `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, 0);` so Put never increases balance by msg.value (always adds 0).
Delete the statement `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>block.timestamp?_unlockTime:block.timestamp;` so unlockTime is never updated by Put.
Delete the statement `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value);` so Put never updates the balance.
Delete the body of the modifier (leave only `_;`) so the nonReentrant guard effectively does nothing, allowing reentrant calls during Put.
Replace `require(!locked_);` with `require(locked_);` in the modifier, inverting the reentrancy guard and potentially blocking legitimate first calls.

Replace `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>block.timestamp?_unlockTime:block.timestamp;` with `acc.unlockTime = block.timestamp;` to always set unlockTime to the current block timestamp regardless of argument.
Remove the unlockTime check so Collect succeeds even before unlockTime
Remove the minimum balance check so Collect succeeds for amounts below MinSum
Delete the statement that updates acc.balance so the balance does not decrease on successful Collect
Remove the locked_ = true assignment so the reentrancy guard never locks, allowing reentrancy in Collect
Change the balance check to allow Collect when balance is strictly greater than amount rather than greater or equal
